_about: What a plain spot can hold besides a fight (Robin, 2026-11-02: 'it needs to be more interesting landing on spots... like roll a 6 to get a good piece of armor... rare and special, and tied to something that makes sense'). Words and numbers mine. A find is a single roll: `need` or better for a piece of `slot`, one rarity up at least.

events.text: A quiet picnic spot in the clover: you rest a while.
A shepherd shares bread and cheese with you.
You fall in a ditch full of nettles. Ouch.
Something glints under a mole hill: a lost purse.
A farmer pays you to chase a goat off the barley.
A warm breeze off the sea clears your head.
A herb wife presses a little bottle into your hand.
A card flutters down from a passing cart.

finds.text: A rusted cuirass sticks out of the river bank. Pull it free?
A scarecrow wears a fine old helm. Knock it down?
A blade lies under a fallen millstone. Heave it up?
A soldier's boots hang high in an old apple tree. Climb for them?

events.text: A mossy hollow, soft as a bed: you doze a moment.
Sweet sap drips from an old oak. You lick your fingers.
Brambles close round you. You tear your way out.
A magpie's nest, full of stolen coins.
A nutkin drops its purse and runs.
Glowing motes drift through you, cool and bright.
A flask sits on a stump with a note: for the brave.
A fox trots up with a card in its teeth, drops it, and goes.

finds.text: Roots have grown through an old suit of armour. Tear it loose?
A cloak hangs in a giant web, the spider long gone. Reach for it?
A charm is sunk in a tree's bark, the wood healed round it. Dig it out?
A weapon stands in a stone, moss to the hilt. Try it?

events.text: Harvesters wave you over for cider in the shade.
You eat your fill of ripe plums.
You put your hand in a wasp's nest. It was not empty.
A coin jar turns up in a haystack.
A miller pays you to carry a sack to the road.
Bees hum a low sweet note and your thoughts settle.
A jar of honey tonic on a fence post: help yourself.
A scarecrow's pocket holds a card.

finds.text: A scarecrow is wearing real plate under the straw. Pull it off?
Something heavy is buried under the old press. Dig for it?
A pair of fine gloves, stuck fast in a honeycomb. Work them free?
A blade in the barn rafters, out of reach. Jump for it?

events.text: A glowing pool in the dark: you drink, and feel better.
A root swings out of the dark and clips you.
Old coins lie where the roots have split a stone.
The mushrooms hum, and your head clears.
A little bottle sits on a ledge, still corked.

finds.text: A helm hangs tangled in the roots. Pull it free?
Something shines under a heavy stone. Heave it up?

events.text: A stilt-house keeper lets you dry off by the fire.
A leech gets you behind the knee. Ugh.
A purse floats by on a lily pad.
A lantern over the water hums, and your head clears.
A marsh wife hands you a stoppered bottle.
A card drifts past on the black water.

finds.text: A rusted helm sits on a sunk stump. Wade out for it?
Boots stick out of the mud, with nobody in them. Pull?
A cape is snagged high in a dead cypress. Climb?

events.text: A herder shares hot soup by a sheltered fire.
A slide of loose stones catches you on the shin.
Old coins lie frozen in a crack. You chip them free.
The thin clean air clears your head.
A climber left a flask on a cairn, for whoever comes next.
A card flutters out of a frozen pack.

finds.text: A shield is frozen into a wall of ice. Hack it out?
Fine gloves on a frozen climber who no longer needs them. Take them?
Something bright lies on a ledge above the drop. Reach for it?

events.text: A ship’s cook hands you a bowl of something hot.
A crab gets you by the toe. Ow.
A purse washes up at your feet.
The sea breeze clears your head.
A sailor presses a stoppered bottle on you, for luck.
A card blows along the sand.

finds.text: A chest’s rusty lid shows through the sand. Dig?
A hat hangs high up the rigging of a wreck. Climb?
A cutlass is wedged in a broken mast. Pull?

events.text: A hermit shares a mug of something that steams.
A snowdrift drops off a ledge, right onto you.
A frozen purse cracks out of the ice.
The cold air clears your head.
A dwarf on the road gives you a stoppered bottle, for the cold.
A card lies frozen on the path.

finds.text: A chest sticks out of a snowbank. Dig?
A helm sits high on a giant’s cairn. Climb?
A blade is frozen in the ice. Pull?

events.text: A cold spring runs from a king’s tomb. You drink.
A stone falls from the old roof, onto you.
A coin rolls out of the dark to your feet. Then more.
The silence clears your head.
A stoppered bottle stands on a tomb, as if left for you.
A card lies on a dead king’s chest.

finds.text: A chest sits under a fallen banner. Lift it?
A crown of a helm rests high on a statue. Climb?
A blade lies in a stone hand. Pull?
